plain_statement: KM0: AND/OR gates listing two earlier wires each, on N points and N lines, each AND with an input reading no line or two reading no point. Assume the (k + 2)N - 1 bound for 1 <= k <= q. On a plane of order q, N = q^2 + q + 1, a KM0 circuit true on every input of one point and one line through it, and false on every input with at most q lines and no incident pair, has at least N(q + 2) - 1 gates.
title: Conditional on the plane bound at k lines: on a plane of order q, AND/OR fan-in-2 KM0 circuits sound at q lines have at least N(q + 2) - 1 gates
